lines.text: The LORD tells Joshua to designate the cities of refuge, as instructed through Moses, for anyone who kills unintentionally.
The one who flees stands at the city gate and states his case before the priests.
The elders must not surrender the manslayer to the avenger, and he stays until the high priest dies.
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee, Shechem in Ephraim's hill country, and Kiriath-arba in Judah's hill country.
East of Jericho they designated Bezer, Ramoth in Gilead, and Golan in Bashan, for Israelites but not foreigners.

wrong_details.true: all the Israelites and foreigners among them
